title: STNFS at theta=455/1000, 1-SE descent relation input (63.97), boot (214,40,16,4), pad 1.61, charge 100, metered cap, BW 26x5: 2^122.288

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.3903, displayed directed bound 0.3903, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). The relation-collection region is theta=455/1000 on the A^2=2^21 lattice (a uniform sub-region of the certified sampled pool), with exact certified lattice-count products at radius 976 of 0.974253611 (yield) and 1.024869209 (work), leaving the point-estimate relation margin at 0.3004 bits (above the model's 0.30 floor). The sampled relation-collection work carries an 11.43% canonical-work allowance equal to 4.40 incidence-inclusive standard errors (2.597%) of the total-work estimator over the 1806 contributing draws of the 20000-draw pool, computed in the experiment; the raw callgrind log behind the charged main-phase constants (LINE_TAB, REC_TAB, apply, recover, scan, nbound31, ecm12, with brute-force correctness checks) is included as measurements12.txt. The two-log descent model is evaluated with the conservative relation-count input Pm.LOG2_RELS = floor(100*(log2_rels - 1.00*yield_se))/100 = 63.97, one pool standard error (0.1268 bits) below the run's log2_rels=64.1303, and the experiment checks this inequality against the 1-SE lower value. Block-Wiedemann block sizes are m=26, n=5 (linear algebra 2^119.4682). The descent boot is (n1,nA,kA,R)=(214,189.83,16,4); the expected two-log work is 2^118.829 and the meter is 2^119.671, so the success bound charges Markov P(cap reached) <= 2^-0.842 and repeated ideals <= 2^-5.33. A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.288 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.287160. No operation is dropped. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.288 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool and its theta=455/1000 uniform sub-region, exact certified lattice-count products at radius 976, the incidence-inclusive total-work standard error and the charged 4.50-SE allowance, the ledger, filtering, the block-Wiedemann parameters, the descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; derives the descent relation-count input one pool standard error below the computed yield (63.97) and checks it against that 1-SE lower value; prints total_log2W_full_ledger, work_se_total, modelled_success and within_claim.
